properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued October 5 at 8:53PM EDT until October 5 at 11:15PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
FFWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Gadsden County in Big Bend Florida...
North Central Leon County in Big Bend Florida...

* Until 1115 PM EDT.

* At 853 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 6 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tallahassee, Havana, Midway, Quincy, Gretna, Scotland, Freemont,
Florence, Shady Rest, Gibson, Littman, Hinson, Jamieson,
Branchville, Concord, Dogtown, Quincy Airport, Santa Clara, Orchard
Pond and Darsey.

properties.description:

Raccoon River at Des Moines Fleur Dr affecting Polk County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Raccoon River at Des Moines Fleur Dr, or from Walnut Creek
to the Des Moines River.

* WHEN...Until this evening.

* IMPACTS...At 13.3 feet, SW 30th St is closed from George Flagg
Parkway to Bell Ave. George Flagg Parkway is closed from SW 30th St
to SW 28th St.

this afternoon and continue falling to 4.2 feet Sunday evening.
